sources.title: Disturbing "Baby Canceled" Instagram Post Celebrates Abortion
sources.snippet: A disturbing viral Instagram post that framed the abortion of an unborn baby as a cheerful "cancellation" announcement has drawn widespread condemnation from pro-life observers who called it a disgusting celebration of ending a human life.
